back: If event 1 has m ways and event 2 has n ways (in order), total = m × n.
An arrangement of objects in a definite order. Order matters.
nPr = n^r (each of r positions has n choices).
A selection of objects where order does NOT matter.
nPr = nCr × r! (permutations = combinations × arrangements of each selection).
n! / (p1! × p2! × ... × pk!) where p1, p2, ... are counts of each repeated kind.
nCr = nC(n−r): choosing r is the same as rejecting n−r.
